subject: MAP and close timeline: evaluation cargo transfer & constrained usage protocol
messages:
From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@kitecommerce.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@kitecommerce.com
Date: Sun, 16 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot MAP & dataset exchange for checkout intent eval

Karthik —

Thanks for taking the call last week. KiteCommerce is ready to move forward with a short evaluation: we want to exchange a small set of checkout-intent testcases and a prompt pack to validate retrieval + reranking behavior before committing to Dedicated capacity.

Top asks from our side:
- A mutual action plan (MAP) with milestones to close the pilot in 3 weeks.
- Clear limited-use license (ephemeral, sandbox-only, no production copy).
- A short list of acceptance criteria (latency targets, top-1 accuracy on 200 testcases).

Can you send a draft MAP and a proposed delivery timeline? Procurement would like any hosting/ingress constraints noted.

—Emma
Emma Liu
Head of Product, KiteCommerce
emma.liu@kitecommerce.com

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: Emma Liu <emma.liu@kitecommerce.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 17 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP & dataset exchange for checkout intent eval

Emma —

Appreciate the clear asks. Attached is a working MAP draft (redwood_map_draft_v1.pdf) plus a zipped promptpack sample we propose to exchange under an ephemeral-use agreement (kite_sample_promptpack_v1.zip). Key points upfront: we can commit to a 3-week pilot runway with the following milestones:

1) Day 0: NDA + limited MPA (inline) executed by both teams — procurement trail only.
2) Day 2: Secure sandbox access + credential provisioning (nonprod).
3) Day 4: Delivery of prompt pack + 200 labeled testcases (ephemeral).
4) Days 5–14: Joint evaluation (metrics capture, redlines).
5) Day 18: Acceptance review; Day 21: Close or extend.

Constraints we need noted in the MAP:
- Data must remain in the sandbox project and may not be copied to production systems; ephemeral lease is 30 days unless extended in writing.
- No external redistribution; technical contact will confirm destruction steps.
- We will provide a pre-signed S3 share link for the assets and a short ingestion runbook (nonprod-access-instructions.md).

Next steps: if that layout looks right, Ben will run the commercial items (sample licensing language + any one-time token credits) and Lauren will own acceptance criteria and the test harness. Can you confirm procurement's legal reviewer and a weekday window next week for signatures?

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.com, Emma Liu <emma.liu@kitecommerce.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, procurement@kitecommerce.com
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 08:21:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP & dataset exchange for checkout intent eval

Quick commercial note:

We can offer the pilot on a no-charge eval tier for the first 21 days provided the assets are used strictly within the sandbox and the acceptance gate is performed by KiteCommerce on day 18. If acceptance passes, we will discuss conversion terms (discount on first 6 months of Dedicated capacity). I attached the sample commercial appendix to the MAP (redwood_map_draft_v1.pdf contains the appendix at the end).

Also — procurement: to speed onboarding we need a PO or email approval that confirms sandbox access and the ephemeral asset handling rules. A simple one-paragraph PO is sufficient for our ops team to create the nonprod environment.

-ben
Ben Carter
Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Emma Liu <emma.liu@kitecommerce.com>
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, procurement@kitecommerce.com
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 10:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP & dataset exchange for checkout intent eval

Thanks Ben/Karthik —

Procurement confirms legal will review the MAP; I am looping Tom Barker (procurement@kitecommerce.com) who will provide PO language. Legal asked for two small redlines:

- Reduce the ephemeral lease from 30 days to 21 days.
- Add an explicit acceptance window: KiteCommerce will run automated acceptance tests within 48 hours of receiving assets (we expect day 6–7 for runs).

Both sound reasonable to Redwood? If so, Tom will send the PO and I will sign the MPA after redlines are resolved.

Emma

Emma/Tom —

Those redlines are fine. Updated notes for the MAP and final action items:

- Ephemeral lease: 21 days (auto-expire; ops will confirm deletion).
- Acceptance window: KiteCommerce to run automated tests within 48 hours of asset delivery; acceptance decision by day 18.
- Delivery: Redwood will upload assets to a pre-signed S3 link on Day 4; ops to confirm ACLs.

Tom — if you can send the PO or an email approval with a one-line confirmation of sandbox-only use and the 21-day lease, we will schedule credentialing immediately and deliver on Day 4. I am attaching the ingestion runbook and the MAP v1 with inline redlines.

Looking forward —
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
